entities.summary: Charles Duane Baker Jr. is an American politician serving as the sixth president of the National Collegiate Athletic Association since 2023. A member of the Republican Party, he served as the 72nd governor of Massachusetts from 2015 to 2023, and held two cabinet positions under two of the state's previous governors. He also served for ten years as the CEO of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care.
